name: zmodel_set_display_instance_pool_capacity
description: zModel::SetDisplayInstancePoolCapacity sets the DI/display-instance pool capacity once during model initialization.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this initialization setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel initialization/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x475ff0 validates reading g_zModel_DiPoolCapacity first, reporting the already-sized error when nonzero, and otherwise storing the requested ECX capacity.
The native smoke verifies first assignment, no overwrite after initialization, and preservation of the original unrestricted signed capacity value.
